newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index closes lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index closes lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta shares closed lower on Friday following some profit-taking in selected heavyweights and secondaries, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.44 points, or 0.24 percent, to close at 588.35 points after touching an intra-day low of 586.23 points. Losers led gainers by 54 to 49, with 56 counters unchanged.
Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed in the coming week with focus probably remaining on selected second- and third-liners stocks.
"After consolidating on Friday, I think possible selective foreign buying next week could give a positive tone to the market," said an analyst from a Japanese brokerage.

Some profit-taking on heavyweights including Telkom, satellite operator Indosat and cement producer Semen Gresik had pushed the composite index down but active buying of a few secondaries had prevented steep falls, brokers said.

Telkom fell 100 rupiah to 3,700 on a volume of 2.2 million shares while Indosat fell 50 rupiah to 7,575 on a volume of 256,000 shares. Semen Gresik fell 100 rupiah to 7,000 on a volume of 191,000 shares.
Property firm Duta Anggada topped the active list with 11.4 million shares traded, rising 25 rupiah to 2,200 on rumours that it was in talks with a foreign firm for a joint venture.
Timber firm Barito Pacific rose 75 rupiah to 1,525 on a volume of 6.4 million shares on local-led fresh buying.
Brokers said the rise could be due to perceptions that its price earnings ratio was cheaper than the sector average.
Also, a newspaper on Friday quoted the company's head Prajogo Pangestu as denying speculation that the firm had financial problems. --- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
